WHEN a user requests password reset, THE system SHALL send secure reset link via email within 1 minute.
WHEN account verification times out, THE system SHALL allow re-sending verification email up to 3 times daily.

#### Address Management
THE system SHALL allow customers to store multiple shipping and billing addresses.
WHEN a customer adds an address, THE system SHALL validate format and associate with user account.
THE system SHALL enable customers to set default shipping and billing addresses.
WHEN address validation fails, THE system SHALL display specific error messages and prevent saving incomplete addresses.

#### Product Catalog and Categories
THE system SHALL display products organized by categories with hierarchical structure.
WHEN a guest browses categories, THE system SHALL show all available products without filtering for inventory status.
WHEN a customer searches products, THE system SHALL return results within 2 seconds for queries with up to 1000 products.
THE system SHALL support product filtering by price range, category, brand, and seller.
WHEN advanced search is used, THE system SHALL maintain search context across page navigation.

### User-Specific Capabilities

#### Customer Features
THE system SHALL enable customers to create and manage wishlists with unlimited products.
WHEN a customer adds product to cart, THE system SHALL validate stock availability and prevent adding out-of-stock items.
WHEN cart checkout begins, THE system SHALL apply customer-specific promotions and calculate shipping costs.
THE system SHALL maintain cart contents for 30 days even when logged out.
WHEN order is placed, THE system SHALL process payment, update inventory, and send confirmation within 5 seconds.
THE system SHALL provide real-time order tracking with status updates every 10 minutes for active shipments.
WHEN customer leaves review, THE system SHALL validate purchase history and display after moderator approval.
THE system SHALL allow customers to cancel orders within 24 hours of placement with full refund.
WHEN refund is requested after delivery, THE system SHALL require valid reason and process within 48 hours.

#### Seller Features
WHEN a seller lists product, THE system SHALL validate required fields (title, description, price, images, categories) and prevent duplicate SKUs.
THE system SHALL enable sellers to manage inventory levels per SKU with automatic low-stock alerts at 10 units.
WHEN inventory reaches zero, THE system SHALL automatically disable purchasing for that SKU.
THE system SHALL provide sellers with order notifications within 1 minute of customer purchase.
WHEN seller ships order, THE system SHALL require tracking number input and validate format.
THE system SHALL generate seller-specific sales reports with monthly performance metrics.
WHEN seller requests product removal, THE system SHALL hide product from catalog but maintain order records.

#### Administrative Functions
THE system SHALL provide administrators with dashboard showing platform-wide KPIs (total sales, active users, pending orders).
WHEN administrator reviews products, THE system SHALL enable bulk approval/disapproval actions.
THE system SHALL allow administrators to intervene in order processing when necessary.
WHEN user dispute arises, THE system SHALL create administrative review ticket with priority classification.
THE system SHALL enable administrators to generate and export comprehensive platform reports.
WHEN system maintenance is required, THE system SHALL notify users 24 hours in advance.

### Variant and SKU Management
WHEN seller creates product variants, THE system SHALL enforce that each combination has unique SKU identifier.
THE system SHALL support variants for color, size, style, and material attributes up to 5 dimensions.
WHEN customer selects variant, THE system SHALL update price and availability in real-time.
THE system SHALL prevent adding incompatible variant combinations to cart.

### Integration Requirements
THE system SHALL integrate with payment gateways supporting Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and local bank transfers.
WHEN payment is processed, THE system SHALL handle both success and failure scenarios with appropriate user messaging.
THE system SHALL connect with shipping providers for real-time rate calculation and tracking updates.

- Caching improvements
- Automated testing suite
- Monitoring and alerting systems

- **Search Functionality:** 90% user satisfaction with search relevance and speed

### Performance Benchmarks

WHEN keyword search executes, THE system SHALL return results within 1 second.
WHEN checkout processes payment, THE system SHALL complete transaction within 3 seconds.
WHEN inventory updates occur, THE system SHALL reflect changes within 2 seconds across all user sessions.

THE system SHALL encrypt all payment data using PCI DSS compliant gateways.
WHEN user authentication occurs, THE system SHALL use JWT tokens with 15-minute expiration.
THE system SHALL implement rate limiting preventing more than 10 failed login attempts per hour per IP.
THE system SHALL comply with GDPR for user data deletion and export requests.
WHEN data breach occurs, THE system SHALL alert all affected users within 72 hours.

- **Customer Satisfaction:** 85% positive completion rate for purchase journeys
- **Seller Adoption:** 70% of sellers active on platform within 90 days
- **Admin Efficiency:** 90% of disputes resolved within 24 hours

THE system SHALL require PostgreSQL database with JSON support for product variants.

THE system SHALL require automated test coverage exceeding 85% for business logic.

THE system SHALL support blue-green deployment strategy without service interruption.
WHEN database migrations occur, THE system SHALL prevent data loss through proper rollback procedures.
THE system SHALL implement feature flags for gradual feature rollout.

- Microservices architecture for seller services
- Global CDN for product images worldwide
- Advanced caching strategies for personalized recommendations
- Database sharding for order history scaling

### Advanced Features
- AI-powered product recommendations
- Marketplace messaging between buyers and sellers
- Advanced analytics dashboard with predictive insights

- Multi-language support for international sellers

- Marketplace commission customization per category

# Security and Compliance Requirements for Shopping Mall Platform

## Executive Summary

This document outlines the critical security, privacy, and compliance requirements that must be implemented in the e-commerce shopping mall platform ("**ShoppingMall**"). The platform handles sensitive customer information, payment data, and seller business operations, requiring robust protection against unauthorized access, data breaches, and regulatory violations.

The security framework focuses on three core pillars: protecting user privacy, ensuring secure financial transactions, and maintaining compliance with global regulations. All requirements are specified from a business perspective, defining WHAT the system must do rather than HOW it should be technically implemented.

These requirements ensure the platform maintains customer trust, protects business data, and enables sustainable operation across multiple jurisdictions.

## User Data Privacy Requirements

### Personal Information Collection and Consent

WHEN a user registers on the platform, THE system SHALL obtain explicit consent for collecting and processing their personal data in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

THE system SHALL maintain a clear privacy policy that explains how user data is collected, used, stored, and shared with third parties.

WHEN a guest browses the platform without registration, THE system SHALL avoid collecting personal identifiable information and SHALL only collect anonymized usage statistics for analytics purposes.

### Data Minimization Principles

THE system SHALL collect only the minimum user information necessary to provide platform services:
- Customer registration requires email address, name, and shipping addresses
- Seller registration requires business name, contact details, and legal tax identification
- Payment processing requires card details only for transaction authorization

IF any non-essential data is collected, THE system SHALL allow users to opt-out and SHALL provide clear justification for the collection.

### User Data Access and Control

THE system SHALL provide customers with a complete dashboard to view and manage their personal information, including:
- All stored personal details and order history
- Communication preferences and marketing consent settings
- Active data sharing agreements with third parties

WHEN a customer requests data portability, THE system SHALL provide their complete data profile in a machine-readable format within 30 days of the request.

### Right to Deletion

WHEN a customer requests account deletion, THE system SHALL:
- IMMEDIATELY remove all personal data except required business records
- ANONYMIZE order history while maintaining transaction audit trail
- TERMINATE any data sharing agreements established by the customer
- PROVIDE confirmation of complete deletion within 7 business days

THE system SHALL retain anonymized transaction data for accounting and tax compliance purposes, but SHALL ensure no personally identifiable information remains accessible.

## Payment Security Standards

### Payment Data Handling

WHEN processing payment transactions, THE system SHALL protect sensitive card information and SHALL not store complete card details beyond immediate authorization.

THE system SHALL implement tokenization for payment processing, WHERE payment providers SHALL handle actual card data and return secure tokens for subsequent use.

### Transaction Security

WHEN a customer initiates payment checkout, THE system SHALL verify card information through secure authorization channels and SHALL store only transaction identifiers, not full card details.

THE system SHALL maintain PCI DSS compliance standards, WHERE payment processing SHALL occur through certified gateway providers with Level 1 PCI compliance.

### Refund and Chargeback Protection

WHEN processing refunds, THE system SHALL verify seller authorization and SHALL maintain secure audit trails for all financial adjustments.

THE system SHALL protect against fraudulent chargebacks through transaction documentation and SHALL provide sellers with automated dispute evidence submission capabilities.

## Authentication Security Measures

### Password Security Requirements

WHEN registering accounts, THE system SHALL enforce strong password requirements INCLUDING minimum 12 characters, complex patterns with upper/lower case, numbers, and special characters.

THE system SHALL implement password hashing with industry-standard algorithms and SHALL never store plaintext passwords in the database.

### Multi-Factor Authentication

THE system SHALL support multi-factor authentication (MFA) options including SMS codes, email verification, and authenticator app tokens.

FOR admin and seller accounts, THE system SHALL REQUIRE multi-factor authentication as a mandatory security measure.

WHEN recovering forgotten passwords, THE system SHALL verify user identity through multiple secure channels before allowing password reset.

### Session Management

THE system SHALL implement secure session handling with automatic expiration after 30 minutes of inactivity for customer accounts and 15 minutes for admin accounts.

WHEN detecting suspicious login attempts, THE system SHALL implement progressive security measures including account lockouts and IP address restrictions.

### Authorization Framework

THE system SHALL implement role-based access control (RBAC) aligned with user actor definitions:
- Guest users can only browse and search products
- Customer users can manage their account, orders, and reviews
- Seller users can manage their products and order fulfillment
- Admin users have full system oversight capabilities

WHERE a user attempts actions beyond their permissions, THE system SHALL deny access and SHALL provide clear error messaging.

## Data Retention Policies

### Transaction Records

THE system SHALL retain complete order and payment records for 7 years to meet tax compliance and legal audit requirements.

THE system SHALL retain anonymized sales analytics data indefinitely for business intelligence and trend analysis purposes.

### User Communication History

THE system SHALL retain customer support chat logs for 3 years from conversation date for quality assurance and legal defense purposes.

THE system SHALL retain email notification records for 2 years to support delivery verification and dispute resolution.

### System Logs and Audit Trails

THE system SHALL maintain comprehensive security and access logs for 5 years, INCLUDING login attempts, configuration changes, and API access patterns.

FOR GDPR compliance in European jurisdictions, THE system SHALL provide users with data access requests and SHALL delete personal data logs upon user request, subject to retention minima for legal compliance.

### Archival Strategy

WHEN data exceeds active retention periods, THE system SHALL move it to secure archival storage with access controls for compliance and audit purposes.

THE system SHALL regularly review and update retention policies based on changing regulatory requirements and SHALL notify users of significant policy changes.

## Regulatory Compliance Needs

### EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

WHEN operating in European jurisdictions, THE system SHALL comply with GDPR requirements INCLUDING:
- Lawful basis documentation for all personal data processing
- Data minimization and purpose limitation principles
- User rights to access, rectify, and erase their personal data
- Data breach notification within 72 hours to supervisory authorities
- Appointment of a Data Protection Officer for regulatory compliance

### Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

THE system SHALL achieve and maintain PCI DSS Level 1 certification through:
- Secure handling of cardholder data during transmission and storage
- Regular security assessments by Qualified Security Assessors
- Implementation of network segmentation for payment processing
- Annual compliance audits and penetration testing requirements

### California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)

WHERE applicable to California residents, THE system SHALL provide CCPA compliance INCLUDING:
- "Do Not Sell My Personal Information" opt-out capabilities
- Detailed privacy notices explaining data collection practices
- Subject rights to know about personal data collection and deletion
- Non-discrimination policy for privacy choices

### International E-commerce Compliance

THE system SHALL maintain compliance with jurisdiction-specific requirements INCLUDING:
- Korea's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) for data subject rights
- Canada's PIPEDA for cross-border data transfers
- Australia's Privacy Act for consumer data handling
- Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD) framework

WHEN expanding to new markets, THE system SHALL conduct local regulatory assessment and SHALL update compliance requirements accordingly.

## Performance and Security Balance

### Response Time Requirements

WHEN handling authentication attempts, THE system SHALL respond within 2 seconds under normal load and SHALL maintain security validation during peak usage periods.

THE system SHALL implement rate limiting to prevent brute-force attacks while allowing legitimate user access during high-traffic periods.

### Scalability Security

WHEN the platform scales to handle increased user loads, THE system SHALL maintain consistent security posture and SHALL not compromise security measures for performance gains.

THE system SHALL conduct regular security assessments and SHALL update protection measures based on emerging threats and platform growth.

## Success Criteria and Validation

The security and compliance implementation SHALL be considered successful WHEN:
- External audits confirm PCI DSS Level 1 certification achievement
- Privacy compliance tools verify GDPR, CCPA, and PIPA adherence
- Penetration testing identifies no critical security vulnerabilities
- All user actor roles maintain appropriate access boundaries
- Data breach response procedures are tested and validated annually

## Business Impact of Security Implementation

### Customer Trust Foundation

Strong security measures directly contribute to customer acquisition and retention by demonstrating commitment to data protection and privacy.

### Seller Confidence

Comprehensive security protects seller business data and enables secure platform operations, encouraging seller participation and platform growth.

### Regulatory Compliance

Proactive compliance reduces legal risks, enables international expansion, and maintains access to regulated markets with strict data protection requirements.

### Platform Sustainability

Security breaches could result in financial penalties, business interruption, and permanent damage to brand reputation, all of which are mitigated through these comprehensive requirements.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description:
Platform sections defining different areas or departments within the shopping mall. Sections organize the platform into logical divisions, supporting hierarchical structures with parent-child relationships. This enables complex navigation patterns and specialized marketplace areas.

The hierarchical design allows for unlimited nesting levels, enabling complex organizational structures. Each section can contain sub-sections, creating a tree-like navigation system. Priority fields enable custom ordering within each level of the hierarchy.

Visibility controls determine which sections are publicly accessible, supporting phased rollouts or maintenance modes. Soft deletion preserves historical navigation patterns while removing outdated sections.

foreignFields.name: parent_section_id

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.name: priority

plainFields.name: is_visible
plainFields.description: Whether this section is publicly visible in navigation. Allows hidden sections for setup or maintenance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created. Tracks when navigation structure was established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last modified. Monitors changes to navigation structure.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted. Preserves navigation history while hiding outdated sections.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Customer accounts representing users who browse and purchase products on the shopping mall platform. 

Customers are the primary purchasing actors who register accounts to complete orders, track purchases, and manage their preferences. Each customer maintains authentication credentials and can create multiple shipping addresses. The customer entity serves as the central user identity for all ordering and shopping activities.

Customers can independently create accounts without seller or admin involvement, manage their personal information, and access complete order history. This table establishes the foundation for personalized shopping experiences and customer relationship management.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for customer registration and authentication. This serves as the unique identifier for login and receives transactional notifications, order confirmations, and password recovery emails. The address must follow standard email format and is used for all customer communications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed version of customer password for secure authentication. Password must be at least 8 characters with complex requirements. Used during login to verify user identity and should never be stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer account was first registered. Used for account age tracking and audit purposes, displaying join date in user profile.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last customer profile modification. Tracks account maintenance activities and profile updates for data integrity.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for customer accounts. Allows preserving historical order data while preventing new logins and purchases. Customers can be restored within data retention policies.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking customer device access and login activities for security monitoring.

Customer sessions record each login instance with device information, access timestamps, and IP tracking for security auditing and account activity monitoring. These sessions enable persistent authentication while tracking user engagement patterns.

Sessions capture connection context at login time, including IP addresses and referrer URLs, supporting fraud detection and security investigations. Each customer can maintain multiple concurrent sessions across different devices and browsers.

Sessions expire automatically after extended periods of inactivity to ensure account security, requiring re-authentication for continued access.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Target shopping_mall_customers.id identifier for the authenticated customer session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used by the customer device during authentication. Enables geographic and security analysis, tracking login locations and detecting suspicious access patterns.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed by customer during connection initiation, typically the login page or checkout process. Useful for tracking user journey and authorization context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the customer's browser, indicating the page that linked to the login process. Helps understand user navigation patterns and potential security issues.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer session was established through successful authentication. Marks the start of authenticated activity tracking.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer session naturally expired or was terminated. Used for session lifecycle management and activity reporting.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Seller accounts representing merchants who list and manage products on the shopping mall platform.

Sellers are independent merchants with their own product catalogs, inventory management, and order fulfillment responsibilities. Each seller maintains authentication credentials including multi-factor authentication for enhanced security. Sellers independently create accounts, establish business profiles, and operate their marketplace presence.

Sellers handle product pricing, inventory tracking, and customer service for their listings. This table supports the core business model of connecting sellers with customers in a scalable marketplace.

Seller accounts enable commission-based revenue sharing while providing sellers with comprehensive authentication security including mandatory MFA requirements.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for seller registration and authentication. Serves as the unique identifier for login and receives critical notifications about orders, inventory alerts, and platform updates. Must be a business email for verification purposes.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed version of seller password for secure authentication. Password must meet complexity requirements including minimum length and character variety. Critical for protecting merchant account access and business data.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is activated for this seller account. Required by security policy to be enabled for all seller accounts to protect business operations and customer data.

plainFields.name: mfa_method
plainFields.description: The multi-factor authentication method configured for this seller account. Valid values: 'sms' for SMS verification, 'email' for additional email verification, 'app' for authenticator app integration. Required when MFA is enabled.

plainFields.name: mfa_secret
plainFields.description: Secret key used for authenticator app-based MFA integration. Stored securely and used to verify time-based one-time passwords. Only populated when mfa_method is 'app'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller account was first registered and approved. Used for seller onboarding tracking and establishing account seniority in performance reporting.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last seller profile or settings modification. Tracks account maintenance and business profile updates for audit and compliance purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for seller accounts. Preserves historical product and order data while preventing new listings and access. Supports seller re-enrollment if affairs are resolved.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking seller device access and login activities for business account monitoring.

Seller sessions record each login instance with device information and access tracking for security auditing and business activity monitoring. These sessions support multi-device access for merchants managing their online business.

Sessions capture connection context including IP addresses and access URLs, enabling security monitoring and fraud prevention for seller accounts. Multiple concurrent sessions allow sellers to manage their business from different devices.

Sessions provide audit trails for business activities and help monitor seller engagement with the marketplace platform.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Target shopping_mall_sellers.id identifier for the authenticated seller session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used by the seller device during authentication. Supports geographic analysis and detection of unauthorized access to business accounts.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed by seller during connection initiation, typically dashboard or inventory management pages. Tracks business activity entry points.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source page that led to seller authentication. Helps understand seller workflow and navigation patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller session was established through successful authentication. Marks the beginning of business activity auditing period.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when seller session was terminated through logout or automatic expiration. Supports session lifecycle reporting and security monitoring.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Administrator accounts representing platform operators who oversee and manage the shopping mall ecosystem.

Administrators are platform operators responsible for system integrity, user support, and operational management. They maintain authentication credentials including multi-factor authentication for enhanced security. Admins independently manage their operator accounts, handle user disputes, moderate content, and monitor platform performance.

Admins ensure fair marketplace practices and technical operations while maintaining audit trails for all administrative actions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for admin registration and authentication. Serves as the unique identifier for login and receives critical system alerts, user escalations, and platform maintenance notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed version of admin password for secure authentication. Requires enhanced complexity for high-privilege accounts with regular password rotation policies.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is activated for this admin account. Required by security policy to be enabled for all administrator accounts to protect platform operations and sensitive data access.

plainFields.name: mfa_method
plainFields.description: The multi-factor authentication method configured for this admin account. Valid values: 'sms' for SMS verification, 'email' for additional email verification, 'app' for authenticator app integration. Required when MFA is enabled.

plainFields.name: mfa_secret
plainFields.description: Secret key used for authenticator app-based MFA integration. Stored securely and used to verify time-based one-time passwords. Only populated when mfa_method is 'app'.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for admin accounts. Preserves administrative action history while revoking access permissions. Supports account deactivation for compliance purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions tracking administrator device access and login activities for platform security monitoring.

Admin sessions record each login instance with detailed tracking for security auditing and access control monitoring. These sessions support privileged account usage with enhanced security requirements.

Sessions capture comprehensive connection context including IP addresses and access patterns, enabling security monitoring and compliance reporting for administrative activities. Multiple sessions allow operators to manage different aspects of the platform.

Sessions provide audit trails for all administrative actions and help maintain accountability for platform modifications and user management decisions.

plainFields.name: expired_at

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product catalog entries representing items available for purchase on the shopping mall platform.

Stores complete product information including basic metadata, categorization, and seller association. Each product serves as the parent entity for multiple variants that represent different configurations like sizes, colors, or styles. The product table maintains business integrity without embedding pricing or inventory data, which is properly normalized into the variants table.

Products are searchable and browsable independently, supporting primary stance with full CRUD API endpoints for seller management. The product description serves as the foundation for detailed product presentations, while variants handle specific purchasing options.

Key relationships include categorization through the category foreign key and seller ownership through the seller association. Soft deletion is supported to maintain referential integrity while allowing product retirement.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category classification for the product. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Associated seller who manages this product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name/title displayed in catalog and search results. Must be unique within seller's catalog to prevent confusion.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description providing comprehensive information about features, specifications, and usage. Supports rich text formatting for enhanced presentation.

plainFields.name: base_sku
plainFields.description: Base SKU identifier for the product, used as prefix for variant SKUs. Helps track product families while ensuring unique identification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product availability status. Valid values: active, inactive, discontinued. Controls whether product appears in search and browsing interfaces.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was first created in the system. Essential for audit trails and chronological sorting.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to product information. Supports caching invalidation and change tracking.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to maintain product references while removing from active catalog. Allows recovery and maintains historical orders.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Product variant configurations that extend base products with specific purchasing options.

Provides granular control over product variations including different sizes, colors, styles, and material options. Each variant contains individual pricing and inventory management, supporting precise e-commerce operations without denormalizing data into the parent product table. This separate table maintains strict 3NF compliance while enabling flexible product catalog management.

Variants are managed through parent product relationships with subsidiary stance, meaning they are created and updated via product management APIs. Each variant represents a distinct SKU that customers can select during the purchase process, with independent stock levels and pricing.

The table supports multiple attribute dimensions to handle complex product variations while maintaining data integrity. Foreign keys ensure variants are properly associated with their parent products.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product this variant belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique SKU identifier for this specific variant, combining parent product SKU with variant attributes. Used for inventory tracking and order processing.

plainFields.name: variant_attributes
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted variant specifications like size, color, or style combinations. Enables flexible product configurations while maintaining structured data integrity.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Specific price point for this variant in decimal format. Supports different pricing strategies across variant combinations while maintaining precision.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Available inventory units for this specific variant. Must be maintained accurately to prevent overselling during concurrent purchases.

plainFields.name: stock_status
plainFields.description: Current availability status for the variant. Valid values: in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock. Automatically calculated based on stock_quantity thresholds.

plainFields.name: images
plainFields.description: JSON array of image URLs specific to this variant configuration. Supports multiple images for different variant appearances.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was first created. Supports audit trails and chronological variant management.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to variant information. Essential for stock level change tracking and price updates.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for variant retirement while maintaining historical order references. Allows variant lifecycle management.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Customer feedback and rating system for products purchased on the platform.

Captures authentic customer experiences through rating scores and detailed feedback comments. Reviews serve as independent entities that users can create, read, update, and delete, supporting primary stance with full CRUD API endpoints. This design enables customers to manage their feedback independently across different devices and sessions.

Each review validates against purchase history to ensure authenticity, requiring both customer and product relationships. The review system supports multiple reviews per customer-product combination when customers make repeated purchases, enabling ongoing feedback updated after multiple experiences. Soft deletion is supported to handle review moderation while maintaining data integrity.

Reviews are indexed for full-text search on content and comments, supporting platform-wide sentiment analysis and customer feedback aggregation. The table includes comprehensive audit trails with creation and update timestamps.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this review for purchase validation. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Numeric rating score from 1 to 5 stars. Provides quantitative feedback that supports average calculations and sorting.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Review headline or summary title. Provides quick overview and supports search indexing for customer feedback.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Detailed review content and comments. Contains customer feedback, experiences, and specific observations about the product.

plainFields.name: verified_purchase
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the review comes from a verified purchase. Builds trust and prevents fake reviews.

plainFields.name: helpful_votes
plainFields.description: Community helpfulness score based on customer upvoting. Supports review ranking and quality identification.

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status of the review. Valid values: pending, approved, rejected, flagged. Controls review visibility to other customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was first submitted. Critical for chronological display and review freshness assessment.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to review content. Supports edit tracking and moderation changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to handle review removal while preserving order references and providing recovery options.

models.name: shopping_mall_coupons
models.description: Coupon definitions and configurations for promotional discount campaigns. Supports various discount types including percentage discounts, fixed amount reductions, and special offer promotions. Each coupon has unique code for customer redemption, configurable usage limits, and time-based validity windows. Coupons can be targeted at specific customer segments or applied platform-wide.

plainFields.name: code

plainFields.name: type

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_coupon_redemptions

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Customer wishlists for saving desired products for future purchase consideration.

This entity manages user-created lists where customers can collect and organize products they are interested in buying later. Each wishlist belongs to exactly one customer and can contain multiple product items. Wishlists enhance the shopping experience by allowing customers to track items across browsing sessions and receive notifications when items become restocked or go on sale.

Wishlists support multiple lists per customer for organizational purposes, such as gift lists, personal purchases, or saving items for different shopping occasions. The system maintains audit trails for wishlist creation and modifications to support user account management and historical tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the wishlist.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Individual product items within customer wishlists.

This entity connects specific product variants to wishlists, allowing customers to save particular product configurations. Each wishlist item represents one product variant that a customer has added to their wishlist. Items include optional quantity information for customers who are saving multiple units of the same product.

Wishlist items enable customers to track product availability changes, receive restock notifications, and move items to their shopping cart when ready to purchase. The system prevents duplication of the same product variant within a single wishlist.

### `shopping_mall_categories`

Product categories for organizing items in the shopping mall. Each
category represents a classification group that products can belong to,
supporting hierarchical organization with multilingual support.
Categories help customers navigate products efficiently and enable
targeted promotions. Derived from systematic component, this table serves
as a reference for product listings across all sellers.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`: Category name used for navigation and display.
- `description`: Detailed category description explaining the types of products included.
- `priority`: Display order priority for category listing, lower numbers appear first.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the category was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the category was last modified.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_channels`

Sales channels representing different methods of product distribution
within the shopping mall platform. Channels allow sellers to offer
products through various strategies like direct online sales,
marketplace, or wholesale channels. Each channel maintains separate
pricing and terms, supporting flexible business models.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`: Channel name identifier for display and reference.
- `description`: Detailed description of the channel's business model and terms.
- `type`: Channel type classification (online, offline, wholesale, etc.).
- `commission_rate`: Platform commission percentage applied to sales in this channel.
- `is_active`: Whether this channel is currently operational.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the channel was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the channel was last modified.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sections`

Platform sections defining different areas or departments within the
shopping mall. Sections organize the platform into logical divisions,
supporting hierarchical structures with parent-child relationships. This
enables complex navigation patterns and specialized marketplace areas.

The hierarchical design allows for unlimited nesting levels, enabling
complex organizational structures. Each section can contain sub-sections,
creating a tree-like navigation system. Priority fields enable custom
ordering within each level of the hierarchy.

Visibility controls determine which sections are publicly accessible,
supporting phased rollouts or maintenance modes. Soft deletion preserves
historical navigation patterns while removing outdated sections.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `parent_section_id`
  > Parent section for hierarchical organization. References
  > shopping_mall_sections.id to create hierarchical relationships.
- `name`
  > Section name for navigation and display. Must be unique within the same
  > parent level, but can repeat across different hierarchy branches.
- `description`
  > Detailed explanation of the section's purpose and contents. Helps users
  > understand what to expect from this section.
- `priority`
  > Display order within parent section, lower numbers appear first. Enables
  > custom ordering that respects hierarchical structure.
- `is_visible`
  > Whether this section is publicly visible in navigation. Allows hidden
  > sections for setup or maintenance.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when the section was created. Tracks when navigation structure
  > was established.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp when the section was last modified. Monitors changes to
  > navigation structure.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted. Preserves navigation history
  > while hiding outdated sections.

### `shopping_mall_customers`

Customer accounts representing users who browse and purchase products on
the shopping mall platform.

Customers are the primary purchasing actors who register accounts to
complete orders, track purchases, and manage their preferences. Each
customer maintains authentication credentials and can create multiple
shipping addresses. The customer entity serves as the central user
identity for all ordering and shopping activities.

Customers can independently create accounts without seller or admin
involvement, manage their personal information, and access complete order
history. This table establishes the foundation for personalized shopping
experiences and customer relationship management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Email address used for customer registration and authentication. This
  > serves as the unique identifier for login and receives transactional
  > notifications, order confirmations, and password recovery emails. The
  > address must follow standard email format and is used for all customer
  > communications.
- `password_hash`
  > Hashed version of customer password for secure authentication. Password
  > must be at least 8 characters with complex requirements. Used during
  > login to verify user identity and should never be stored in plain text.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when customer account was first registered. Used for account
  > age tracking and audit purposes, displaying join date in user profile.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of last customer profile modification. Tracks account
  > maintenance activities and profile updates for data integrity.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp for customer accounts. Allows preserving historical
  > order data while preventing new logins and purchases. Customers can be
  > restored within data retention policies.

### `shopping_mall_customer_sessions`

Authentication sessions tracking customer device access and login
activities for security monitoring.

Customer sessions record each login instance with device information,
access timestamps, and IP tracking for security auditing and account
activity monitoring. These sessions enable persistent authentication
while tracking user engagement patterns.

Sessions capture connection context at login time, including IP addresses
and referrer URLs, supporting fraud detection and security
investigations. Each customer can maintain multiple concurrent sessions
across different devices and browsers.

Sessions expire automatically after extended periods of inactivity to
ensure account security, requiring re-authentication for continued
access.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`
  > Target shopping_mall_customers.id identifier for the authenticated
  > customer session.
- `ip`
  > IP address used by the customer device during authentication. Enables
  > geographic and security analysis, tracking login locations and detecting
  > suspicious access patterns.
- `href`
  > URL accessed by customer during connection initiation, typically the
  > login page or checkout process. Useful for tracking user journey and
  > authorization context.
- `referrer`
  > HTTP referrer header from the customer's browser, indicating the page
  > that linked to the login process. Helps understand user navigation
  > patterns and potential security issues.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when customer session was established through successful
  > authentication. Marks the start of authenticated activity tracking.
- `expired_at`
  > Timestamp when customer session naturally expired or was terminated. Used
  > for session lifecycle management and activity reporting.

### `shopping_mall_sellers`

Seller accounts representing merchants who list and manage products on
the shopping mall platform.

Sellers are independent merchants with their own product catalogs,
inventory management, and order fulfillment responsibilities. Each seller
maintains authentication credentials including multi-factor
authentication for enhanced security. Sellers independently create
accounts, establish business profiles, and operate their marketplace
presence.

Sellers handle product pricing, inventory tracking, and customer service
for their listings. This table supports the core business model of
connecting sellers with customers in a scalable marketplace.

Seller accounts enable commission-based revenue sharing while providing
sellers with comprehensive authentication security including mandatory
MFA requirements.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Email address used for seller registration and authentication. Serves as
  > the unique identifier for login and receives critical notifications about
  > orders, inventory alerts, and platform updates. Must be a business email
  > for verification purposes.
- `password_hash`
  > Hashed version of seller password for secure authentication. Password
  > must meet complexity requirements including minimum length and character
  > variety. Critical for protecting merchant account access and business
  > data.
- `mfa_enabled`
  > Whether multi-factor authentication is activated for this seller account.
  > Required by security policy to be enabled for all seller accounts to
  > protect business operations and customer data.
- `mfa_method`
  > The multi-factor authentication method configured for this seller
  > account. Valid values: 'sms' for SMS verification, 'email' for additional
  > email verification, 'app' for authenticator app integration. Required
  > when MFA is enabled.
- `mfa_secret`
  > Secret key used for authenticator app-based MFA integration. Stored
  > securely and used to verify time-based one-time passwords. Only populated
  > when mfa_method is 'app'.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when seller account was first registered and approved. Used for
  > seller onboarding tracking and establishing account seniority in
  > performance reporting.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of last seller profile or settings modification. Tracks account
  > maintenance and business profile updates for audit and compliance
  > purposes.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp for seller accounts. Preserves historical product
  > and order data while preventing new listings and access. Supports seller
  > re-enrollment if affairs are resolved.

### `shopping_mall_seller_sessions`

Authentication sessions tracking seller device access and login
activities for business account monitoring.

Seller sessions record each login instance with device information and
access tracking for security auditing and business activity monitoring.
These sessions support multi-device access for merchants managing their
online business.

Sessions capture connection context including IP addresses and access
URLs, enabling security monitoring and fraud prevention for seller
accounts. Multiple concurrent sessions allow sellers to manage their
business from different devices.

Sessions provide audit trails for business activities and help monitor
seller engagement with the marketplace platform.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_seller_id`
  > Target shopping_mall_sellers.id identifier for the authenticated seller
  > session.
- `ip`
  > IP address used by the seller device during authentication. Supports
  > geographic analysis and detection of unauthorized access to business
  > accounts.
- `href`
  > URL accessed by seller during connection initiation, typically dashboard
  > or inventory management pages. Tracks business activity entry points.
- `referrer`
  > HTTP referrer header indicating the source page that led to seller
  > authentication. Helps understand seller workflow and navigation patterns.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when seller session was established through successful
  > authentication. Marks the beginning of business activity auditing period.
- `expired_at`
  > Timestamp when seller session was terminated through logout or automatic
  > expiration. Supports session lifecycle reporting and security monitoring.

### `shopping_mall_admins`

Administrator accounts representing platform operators who oversee and
manage the shopping mall ecosystem.

Administrators are platform operators responsible for system integrity,
user support, and operational management. They maintain authentication
credentials including multi-factor authentication for enhanced security.
Admins independently manage their operator accounts, handle user
disputes, moderate content, and monitor platform performance.

Admins ensure fair marketplace practices and technical operations while
maintaining audit trails for all administrative actions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Email address used for admin registration and authentication. Serves as
  > the unique identifier for login and receives critical system alerts, user
  > escalations, and platform maintenance notifications.
- `password_hash`
  > Hashed version of admin password for secure authentication. Requires
  > enhanced complexity for high-privilege accounts with regular password
  > rotation policies.
- `mfa_enabled`
  > Whether multi-factor authentication is activated for this admin account.
  > Required by security policy to be enabled for all administrator accounts
  > to protect platform operations and sensitive data access.
- `mfa_method`
  > The multi-factor authentication method configured for this admin account.
  > Valid values: 'sms' for SMS verification, 'email' for additional email
  > verification, 'app' for authenticator app integration. Required when MFA
  > is enabled.
- `mfa_secret`
  > Secret key used for authenticator app-based MFA integration. Stored
  > securely and used to verify time-based one-time passwords. Only populated
  > when mfa_method is 'app'.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when admin account was first created and authorized. Used for
  > access privilege tracking and administrative role assignments.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of last admin profile or permission modification. Tracks
  > administrative account maintenance and access right changes.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp for admin accounts. Preserves administrative action
  > history while revoking access permissions. Supports account deactivation
  > for compliance purposes.

### `shopping_mall_admin_sessions`

Authentication sessions tracking administrator device access and login
activities for platform security monitoring.

Admin sessions record each login instance with detailed tracking for
security auditing and access control monitoring. These sessions support
privileged account usage with enhanced security requirements.

Sessions capture comprehensive connection context including IP addresses
and access patterns, enabling security monitoring and compliance
reporting for administrative activities. Multiple sessions allow
operators to manage different aspects of the platform.

Sessions provide audit trails for all administrative actions and help
maintain accountability for platform modifications and user management
decisions.

### `shopping_mall_products`

Core product catalog entries representing items available for purchase on
the shopping mall platform.

Stores complete product information including basic metadata,
categorization, and seller association. Each product serves as the parent
entity for multiple variants that represent different configurations like
sizes, colors, or styles. The product table maintains business integrity
without embedding pricing or inventory data, which is properly normalized
into the variants table.

Products are searchable and browsable independently, supporting primary
stance with full CRUD API endpoints for seller management. The product
description serves as the foundation for detailed product presentations,
while variants handle specific purchasing options.

Key relationships include categorization through the category foreign key
and seller ownership through the seller association. Soft deletion is
supported to maintain referential integrity while allowing product
retirement.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_category_id`
  > Category classification for the product. {@link
  > shopping_mall_categories.id}
- `shopping_mall_seller_id`
  > Associated seller who manages this product. {@link
  > shopping_mall_sellers.id}
- `name`
  > Product name/title displayed in catalog and search results. Must be
  > unique within seller's catalog to prevent confusion.
- `description`
  > Detailed product description providing comprehensive information about
  > features, specifications, and usage. Supports rich text formatting for
  > enhanced presentation.
- `base_sku`
  > Base SKU identifier for the product, used as prefix for variant SKUs.
  > Helps track product families while ensuring unique identification.
- `status`
  > Product availability status. Valid values: active, inactive,
  > discontinued. Controls whether product appears in search and browsing
  > interfaces.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when the product was first created in the system. Essential for
  > audit trails and chronological sorting.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of the last modification to product information. Supports
  > caching invalidation and change tracking.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp to maintain product references while removing
  > from active catalog. Allows recovery and maintains historical orders.

### `shopping_mall_product_variants`

Product variant configurations that extend base products with specific
purchasing options.

Provides granular control over product variations including different
sizes, colors, styles, and material options. Each variant contains
individual pricing and inventory management, supporting precise
e-commerce operations without denormalizing data into the parent product
table. This separate table maintains strict 3NF compliance while enabling
flexible product catalog management.

Variants are managed through parent product relationships with subsidiary
stance, meaning they are created and updated via product management APIs.
Each variant represents a distinct SKU that customers can select during
the purchase process, with independent stock levels and pricing.

The table supports multiple attribute dimensions to handle complex
product variations while maintaining data integrity. Foreign keys ensure
variants are properly associated with their parent products.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_id`: Parent product this variant belongs to. [shopping_mall_products.id](#shopping_mall_products)
- `sku`
  > Unique SKU identifier for this specific variant, combining parent product
  > SKU with variant attributes. Used for inventory tracking and order
  > processing.
- `variant_attributes`
  > JSON-formatted variant specifications like size, color, or style
  > combinations. Enables flexible product configurations while maintaining
  > structured data integrity.
- `price`
  > Specific price point for this variant in decimal format. Supports
  > different pricing strategies across variant combinations while
  > maintaining precision.
- `stock_quantity`
  > Available inventory units for this specific variant. Must be maintained
  > accurately to prevent overselling during concurrent purchases.
- `stock_status`
  > Current availability status for the variant. Valid values: in_stock,
  > low_stock, out_of_stock. Automatically calculated based on stock_quantity
  > thresholds.
- `images`
  > JSON array of image URLs specific to this variant configuration. Supports
  > multiple images for different variant appearances.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when the variant was first created. Supports audit trails and
  > chronological variant management.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of the last modification to variant information. Essential for
  > stock level change tracking and price updates.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp for variant retirement while maintaining
  > historical order references. Allows variant lifecycle management.

### `shopping_mall_reviews`

Customer feedback and rating system for products purchased on the platform.

Captures authentic customer experiences through rating scores and
detailed feedback comments. Reviews serve as independent entities that
users can create, read, update, and delete, supporting primary stance
with full CRUD API endpoints. This design enables customers to manage
their feedback independently across different devices and sessions.

Each review validates against purchase history to ensure authenticity,
requiring both customer and product relationships. The review system
supports multiple reviews per customer-product combination when customers
make repeated purchases, enabling ongoing feedback updated after multiple
experiences. Soft deletion is supported to handle review moderation while
maintaining data integrity.

Reviews are indexed for full-text search on content and comments,
supporting platform-wide sentiment analysis and customer feedback
aggregation. The table includes comprehensive audit trails with creation
and update timestamps.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Customer who submitted the review. [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers)
- `shopping_mall_product_id`: Product being reviewed. [shopping_mall_products.id](#shopping_mall_products)
- `shopping_mall_order_id`
  > Order associated with this review for purchase validation. {@link
  > shopping_mall_orders.id}
- `rating`
  > Numeric rating score from 1 to 5 stars. Provides quantitative feedback
  > that supports average calculations and sorting.
- `title`
  > Review headline or summary title. Provides quick overview and supports
  > search indexing for customer feedback.
- `content`
  > Detailed review content and comments. Contains customer feedback,
  > experiences, and specific observations about the product.
- `verified_purchase`
  > Indicates whether the review comes from a verified purchase. Builds trust
  > and prevents fake reviews.
- `helpful_votes`
  > Community helpfulness score based on customer upvoting. Supports review
  > ranking and quality identification.
- `moderation_status`
  > Current moderation status of the review. Valid values: pending, approved,
  > rejected, flagged. Controls review visibility to other customers.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when the review was first submitted. Critical for chronological
  > display and review freshness assessment.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of the last modification to review content. Supports edit
  > tracking and moderation changes.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp to handle review removal while preserving order
  > references and providing recovery options.

### `shopping_mall_carts`

Shopping cart entity representing a customer's active shopping session.

Stores the state of a customer's shopping activities, enabling persistent
cart functionality across browser sessions and device changes. Each cart
belongs to exactly one customer and contains items selected for potential
purchase.

Carts are created implicitly when a customer adds their first item and
persist for 30 days even when logged out. They serve as the container for
shopping cart items and transition into orders during checkout.

The cart lifecycle includes creation through first item addition, updates
through item modifications, and either conversion to orders or automatic
cleanup after inactivity periods.

### `shopping_mall_cart_items`

Individual product items within a shopping cart.

Represents specific product variants added to a customer's cart,
including the selected quantity and variant details. Each cart can
contain multiple items from different products, with validation to
prevent adding out-of-stock variants.

Items are managed through the parent cart operations, ensuring
consistency during bulk modifications and checkout processes. Stock
validation occurs at the time of addition to maintain purchase intent
accuracy.

The item records enable complex shopping behaviors like quantity
adjustments, variant changes, and partial cart operations without
affecting other cart contents.

- `quantity`: Number of units of the product variant added to cart.
- `created_at`: Time when the item was added to the cart.

### `shopping_mall_coupons`

Coupon definitions and configurations for promotional discount campaigns.
Supports various discount types including percentage discounts, fixed
amount reductions, and special offer promotions. Each coupon has unique
code for customer redemption, configurable usage limits, and time-based
validity windows. Coupons can be targeted at specific customer segments
or applied platform-wide.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Unique coupon code for customer redemption. Case-insensitive but stored
  > in uppercase for consistency.
- `type`
  > Discount calculation method: 'percentage' for percent-off, 'fixed' for
  > dollar amount reduction, 'free_shipping' for shipping waivers.
- `value`
  > Discount amount or percentage value depending on type field. For
  > percentage type, represents percent (e.g., 15.0 for 15% off).
- `minimum_order_amount`
  > Minimum cart subtotal required for coupon application. Prevents misuse on
  > small orders.
- `usage_limit`
  > Maximum number of redemptions allowed across all customers. Null
  > indicates unlimited usage.
- `usage_limit_per_customer`
  > Maximum redemptions per individual customer. Prevents single customer
  > abuse.
- `expires_at`
  > Coupon expiration date and time. Coupons become unusable after this
  > timestamp.
- `is_active`
  > Whether the coupon is currently available for redemption. Allows for
  > temporary deactivation without deletion.
- `created_at`: Coupon creation timestamp for audit trails.
- `updated_at`: Last modification timestamp for tracking coupon updates.

### `shopping_mall_coupon_redemptions`

Records of individual coupon usage instances. Tracks which coupon was
applied to which cart or order, when it was redeemed, and by which
customer. Supports audit trails for discount applications and prevents
double-redemption through unique constraints.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_coupon_id`: Reference to the applied coupon. [shopping_mall_coupons.id](#shopping_mall_coupons)
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Customer who redeemed the coupon. [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers)
- `shopping_mall_cart_id`
  > Cart where coupon was applied (if redemption occurred during checkout).
  > [shopping_mall_carts.id](#shopping_mall_carts)
- `shopping_mall_order_id`
  > Order where coupon was used (populated when order is placed). {@link
  > shopping_mall_orders.id}
- `discounted_amount`
  > Actual discount amount applied to the cart/order. Calculated based on
  > coupon type and rules.
- `redeemed_at`: Timestamp when the coupon was redeemed by the customer.

### `shopping_mall_wishlists`

Customer wishlists for saving desired products for future purchase
consideration.

This entity manages user-created lists where customers can collect and
organize products they are interested in buying later. Each wishlist
belongs to exactly one customer and can contain multiple product items.
Wishlists enhance the shopping experience by allowing customers to track
items across browsing sessions and receive notifications when items
become restocked or go on sale.

Wishlists support multiple lists per customer for organizational
purposes, such as gift lists, personal purchases, or saving items for
different shopping occasions. The system maintains audit trails for
wishlist creation and modifications to support user account management
and historical tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`
  > Belonged customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers)
  >
  > Foreign key linking the wishlist to the customer who created and owns it.
- `name`: Wishlist name chosen by the customer for easy identification.
- `description`: Optional description of the wishlist's purpose or contents.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of the last modification to the wishlist.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail and potential recovery.

### `shopping_mall_wishlist_items`

Individual product items within customer wishlists.

This entity connects specific product variants to wishlists, allowing
customers to save particular product configurations. Each wishlist item
represents one product variant that a customer has added to their
wishlist. Items include optional quantity information for customers who
are saving multiple units of the same product.

Wishlist items enable customers to track product availability changes,
receive restock notifications, and move items to their shopping cart when
ready to purchase. The system prevents duplication of the same product
variant within a single wishlist.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_wishlist_id`
  > Belonged wishlist's [shopping_mall_wishlists.id](#shopping_mall_wishlists)
  >
  > Foreign key linking the item to its parent wishlist.
- `shopping_mall_product_variant_id`
  > Referenced product variant's [shopping_mall_product_variants.id](#shopping_mall_product_variants)
  >
  > Foreign key to the specific product variant being saved in the wishlist.
- `quantity`: Number of units the customer wants to save for this product variant.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the item was added to the wishlist.
